speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Spire Sentinel mechanized defense chassis neutralized. Exterior summit catwalk secured. Telemetry reports ambient pressure stabilizing at the intake threshold.

speaker: TITAN
text: TITAN: That scrapheap put up a hell of a fight. Two-thousand meters of vertical climbing, and my solenoids are still humming. Look at that airlock door... built to survive a nuclear strike.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: OCEANUS: Look behind us, everyone. Look down through the stratospheric haze. Neo-Kyoto's skyline is clear. No sky-shield cage, no surveillance grid. The people are awake.

speaker: SURYA
text: SURYA: But the machine's brain still ticks. As long as the Cyber-Nexus operates, the Citadel can reboot the defensive grid and synthesize automated armies in hours.

speaker: AURA
text: AURA: I feel the acoustic vibration through the steel floor. It's not just machinery... it's a hive mind. Petabytes of surveillance algorithms and neural networks, churning behind that bulkhead.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: Terminal override sequence accepted. The security protocols are folding! Stand by... pressure seal breaking!

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Atmospheric purge complete. Central Cyber-Nexus airlock opening. Thermal sensors detecting multi-layered quantum mainframe chambers beyond the portal.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: By the stars... it's a digital labyrinth. Floating holographic data prisms, quantum conduits, automated laser baffles. One wrong step and the mainframe burns you to ash.

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: Then we tread carefully and strike deep. We shatter the Cyber-Nexus core and blind the Citadel forever. Axiom Force—into the Nexus!
